scope: Public-safe G0-G2 candidate evidence for the Open WebUI speech provider sublane: ctranslate2 and python-ctranslate2 4.8.2-1 and python-faster-whisper 1.2.1-1. It does not promote the sublane; promotion or deferral is the separate disposition ticket. Publication, production installation, and the Open WebUI cutover remain outside this record.

ctranslate2.submodule_resolution: Submodule sources are fetched as makepkg git sources and checked out at the tag's gitlinks, so only the CTranslate2 tag carries a checksum; the gitlinks fix every submodule commit.

checks.srcinfo_regenerated: makepkg --printsrcinfo matches the committed .SRCINFO for both recipes
checks.compatibility_matrix: Faster Whisper 1.2.1 requires ctranslate2>=4.0,<5, huggingface_hub>=0.21, tokenizers>=0.13,<1, onnxruntime>=1.14,<2, av>=11, and tqdm; CTranslate2 4.8.2 requires numpy and pyyaml>=5.3,<7. The observed host provider set satisfies every bound (see G2 provider_profile).
checks.upstream_release_review: 4.8.0 moves Thrust to CCCL 2.7.0; 4.8.1 fixes the model-load heap overflow (#2068) and the Whisper align() division by zero (#2065) and hardens legacy converter checkpoint loading (#2036); 4.8.2 fixes StorageView index out-of-bounds reads (#2073), validates model variable sizes (#2091) and StorageView reserve sizes (#2094) before allocation, updates cxxopts to v3.3.1 (#2084), imports converters and specs lazily (#2080), and removes the runtime setuptools requirement (#2096). The 4.8.1..4.8.2 diff touches only those areas, the version, the changelog, and tests. Faster Whisper 1.2.1 has no CTranslate2 4.8 incompatibility.
checks.ctranslate2_4_8_2_mapping: third_party/thrust maps to NVIDIA/cccl; the separate Cub source and nested Thrust submodule setup stay removed; the 4.8.2 cxxopts gitlink is v3.3.1, which already contains the GCC 15 fix (jarro2783/cxxopts 63d1b65a694cfceafc20863afa75df49dfbe6b2a is an ancestor), so the cherry-pick is dropped; the only remaining source edit is the pybind11 pin relaxation; python-ctranslate2 no longer depends on python-setuptools because upstream removed it from install_requires, and python-pytorch stays an optional converter dependency

builder.tool: makepkg -C -f (clean build) on the host with every makedepend already installed; no --nodeps
builder.cmake_backend: CPU only: WITH_OPENBLAS=ON, WITH_RUY=ON, WITH_MKL=OFF, WITH_DNNL=OFF, no CUDA

ownership.unowned_note: Both unowned files are generated system caches, not imported modules. Every imported module and native library outside the overlay is owned by an installed package per pacman -Qo.
ownership.scope_note: Host files are the loaded files under /usr. Three other mapped paths are not package payload: the dynamic linker cache, an anonymous POSIX semaphore, and the fixture script itself.

provider_notes: Importing ctranslate2 4.8.2 no longer loads PyTorch or Transformers: neither appears among the loaded files, although the host's ROCm PyTorch and Transformers remain installed. The loaded host file count fell from 1931 to 607 compared with the 4.8.1 run.
The only setuptools file loaded is _distutils_hack, which the host's setuptools .pth file loads at interpreter start; CTranslate2 does not import setuptools.
PyAV 18.1.0 is installed where the decision's composed profile names 18.0.0; Faster Whisper needs av>=11.
